extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and applicants classifying clothing- and textile-related patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and applying the Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) A41B subclass scheme for shirts, underwear, baby linen, handkerchiefs and related details, materials, and functional features when classifying or preparing patent documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: WARNING: non-limiting references
rubrics_metrics.description: {In this subclass, non-limiting references (in the sense of paragraph 39 of the Guide to the IPC) may still be displayed in the scheme.}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classification entries may include references that are non-limiting; cross-references shown in the scheme do not necessarily limit coverage. Use IPC Guide paragraph 39 for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1/00 Shirts
rubrics_metrics.description: Shirts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes shirts and the following variants/details: with front inserts; convertible into cami-knickers; exchangeably attached to underbodices, drawers, or the like; closures (buttons A44B 1/00; sleeve links A44B 5/00); neckbands; shirt-fronts; stiffeners for neckbands; adjustable neckbands; stiffeners for shirt-fronts; false shirt-fronts (e.g. dickeys) with or without attached collars; means for attaching or fastening to shirts (collar-studs A44B 3/00). A41B 1/00 takes precedence over other collar groups where indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3/00 Collars
rubrics_metrics.description: Collars (A41B 1/00 takes precedence)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers collars and sub-features: methods or devices for their manufacture (e.g., fold-line formings for collars or cuffs A41B 5/00; folding collar or cuff edges while manufacturing A41H 33/00); closures (e.g., tabs); stiffeners for collars; combined stiffening and fastening devices; chemically stiffened collars; collars with supports for neckties or cravats; reversible collars; plastic or paper collars; protectors for collars; fastening to shirts (collar-studs A44B 3/00).

rubrics_metrics.name: 5/00 Fold-line formings for collars or cuffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Fold-line formings for collars or cuffs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers devices or methods to create fold lines in collars or cuffs during manufacture (see cross-references such as A41H 33/00 for related manufacturing methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: 7/00 Cuffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Cuffs (A41B 1/00, A41B 3/00 take precedence; cuff links A44B 5/00)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes closures for cuffs; fastening cuffs to shirts; fastening cuffs to the sleeves of jackets; stiffeners for cuffs; reversible cuffs; protectors for cuffs. Cross-reference to A44B 5/00 for cuff links.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/00 Undergarments
rubrics_metrics.description: Undergarments (corsets A41C 1/00; brassieres A41C 3/00)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level group covering underpants, briefs, knickers, undershirts, combined undergarments, petticoats, protective undergarments, waistbands forming part of undergarments, shoulder-straps forming part of undergarments, and other undergarment-specific features.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/02 Drawers or underpants for men
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawers or underpants for men, with or without inserted crotch or seat parts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes men's underpants and variants with inserted crotch or seat parts; see related subgroups for crotch characterization, releasable connections, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/04 Knickers for ladies
rubrics_metrics.description: Knickers for ladies, with or without inserted crotch or seat parts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes women's knickers and variants; other subgroups characterize openings, separate genital spaces, thongs, and releasable connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/008 Crotch and opening features
rubrics_metrics.description: {characterized by the crotch} {with crotch line opening} {with releasable connection between crotch and front part}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers undergarments characterized by the crotch area, including crotch-line openings and releasable crotch-to-front connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/023 Drawers with inserted crotch/seat parts
rubrics_metrics.description: {with inserted crotch or seat parts}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific subgroup for garments that have separately inserted crotch or seat pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/026 Separate spaces for genitals
rubrics_metrics.description: {with separate spaces for genitals}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Underwear designed with separated compartments for male or female genitalia.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/06 Undershirts; Chemises
rubrics_metrics.description: Undershirts; Chemises
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers lightweight inner garments such as undershirts and chemises.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/10 Combined undergarments
rubrics_metrics.description: Combined undergarments (panti-hose, body-stockings A41B 11/14)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers garments that combine multiple undergarment types (e.g., pantyhose combined with other pieces). Cross-reference to A41B 11/14 for panti-hose/body-stockings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/14 Petticoats
rubrics_metrics.description: Petticoats
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers petticoats and related skirt-type undergarments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/16 Waistbands and closures
rubrics_metrics.description: Waistbands forming part of the undergarments; Closures therefor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers integral waistbands on undergarments and the closure mechanisms associated with them.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9/12 Protective undergarments
rubrics_metrics.description: Protective undergarments (combined with swabs or absorbent pads or specially adapted for supporting them A61F 13/15)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes undergarments designed for protection/absorbency or to support pads; cross-reference to medical A61F 13/15.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/00 Hosiery; Panti-hose
rubrics_metrics.description: Hosiery; Panti-hose (elastic stockings for curative purposes A61F 13/08)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes hosiery and pantyhose; subtopics include decoration and marking; pairing socks; hosiery with sections of different elasticity; seams; reinforcements; interchangeable foot parts; stockings without foot parts; stocking top features; means at the upper end to keep stockings up; antimicrobial/deodorising/perfuming treatments; body-shaping features; and integrated garters or elastic bands at the upper end.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/003 Decoration; Pairing socks
rubrics_metrics.description: . {Decoration; Marking} . {Pairing socks (devices for keeping articles together during laundering D06F 95/008)}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hosiery decoration and marking; devices and methods for pairing socks (see D06F 95/008 for laundering devices).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/004 - 11/008 Hosiery special constructions
rubrics_metrics.description: . {Hosiery with separated toe sections} . {Hosiery made essentially of a multi-ply construction} . {Hosiery with pockets} . {Hosiery with an added sole, e.g. sole made of rubber or leather}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special constructional variants of hosiery such as split-toe, multi-ply, with pockets, or with added soles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/12 Means to keep stockings up
rubrics_metrics.description: . Means at the upper end to keep the stockings up
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Features at the stocking top for retention (suspenders, elastic bands, friction-increasing means, integrated adjustable garters). Cross-reference: A41B 11/04 takes precedence; stocking suspenders A41F 11/00.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/121 - 11/146 Upper-end retention features
rubrics_metrics.description: . {Elastic or flexible yarns knitted into the upper end} . {Elastic or flexible bands attached at the upper end} . {in discontinuous form} . {Integrated adjustable garter} . {having friction increasing means}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific retention options: knitted elastic yarns, attached elastic bands, discontinuous elastic elements, integrated adjustable garters, friction-enhancing coatings or structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11/14 Panti-hose; Body-stockings
rubrics_metrics.description: . Panti-hose; Body-stockings . {connected at the waistband} . {Panti-hose made of two separated stockings}
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers pantyhose and body stockings, including constructions connected at waistband or made from two separated stockings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13/00 Baby linen
rubrics_metrics.description: Baby linen ({patients' garments specially adapted for babies A41D 13/1272;} babies' napkins or holders therefor A61F 13/15)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes babies' overalls (bodysuits, bib overalls), babies' pants (including combinations with absorbent pads or features adapted to support them), manufacturing of baby linen, sleep-positioning features, slip-in bags/swaddling clothes, bodices, bibs, fastening means (e.g., attachment to tray or figure), donning facilities, disposable variants, moisture handling/wicking function, removability, friction/grip reinforcement, fastening from top of a stack of removable layers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15/00 Handkerchiefs
rubrics_metrics.description: Handkerchiefs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes handkerchiefs generally and simulations of breast pocket handkerchiefs and their attachment methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17/00 Selection of special materials for underwear
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection of special materials for underwear
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers choice of materials for undergarments; includes low friction features and other material-based functional choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300/00 Details of shirts, underwear, baby linen or handkerchiefs
rubrics_metrics.description: Details of shirts, underwear, baby linen or handkerchiefs not provided for in other groups of this subclass
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers inserts (elastic, folded), closures, seams, fasteners (hook and loop-type, slide fasteners, snap fasteners, hooks and eyelets), adhesive fastenings, straps or ties, elastic bands, making by welding or gluing, and other detailed construction features.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400/00 Functions or special features
rubrics_metrics.description: Functions or special features of shirts, underwear, baby linen or handkerchiefs not provided for in other groups of this subclass
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes air permeability/ventilation; breathability (vapour permeable and waterproof); therapeutic uses; massage; acupuncture; and other functional or therapeutic features applied to garments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400/34 - 2400/38 Specific functional treatments
rubrics_metrics.description: . antimicrobial or antibacterial . Deodorising or perfuming . Shaping the contour of the body or adjusting the ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific functional or treatment-related features such as antimicrobial/antibacterial treatments, deodorising/perfuming treatments, and body-shaping/contour-adjusting constructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500/00 Materials for shirts, underwear, baby linen or handkerchiefs
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials for shirts, underwear, baby linen or handkerchiefs not provided for in other groups of this subclass
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material categories: knitted, woven, non-woven, papers, synthetic resins or rubbers; forms such as sheet form or coated form; subdivisions include 2500/10, 2500/20, 2500/30, 2500/40, 2500/50, 2500/52, 2500/54 etc for more specific material forms and treatments.
